hints.title: Count Character Frequencies
hints.text: Count frequencies of each character from a to z. Then simulate the picking process in rounds.

hints.title: Alternate Forward and Backward Passes
hints.text: In the forward step, pick each character with positive count in ascending order. In the backward step, pick each in descending order.

hints.title: Repeat Until Exhausted
hints.text: Continue alternating passes until all character counts reach zero. Append chosen characters to the result string.
